findings.kind: dimension chain does not add up
findings.element: Top horizontal dimension chain (30 | 5.86 | 11,5 | 4.00 | 30) vs. overall dimension 10.00
findings.explanation: The sub-dimensions sum to 0.30 + 5.86 + 0.115 + 4.00 + 0.30 = 10.575 m, but the overall dimension line above reads 10.00 m and the building is drawn exactly 283.46 pt = 10.00 m wide. The chain overshoots the total by 0.575 m. Drawn chain is 0.30 + 5.80 + 0.115 + 3.485 + 0.30 = 10.00 m.

findings.kind: dimension label does not match drawn geometry
findings.element: Dimension chain segment for the WOHNEN clear width (between inner face of left exterior wall x=121.89 and vertical partition x=286.30)
findings.explanation: The dimensioned distance measures 164.41 pt = 5.800 m at 1:100, not 5.86 m. Label is 0.06 m too large.

findings.kind: dimension label does not match drawn geometry
findings.element: Dimension chain segment for the SCHLAFEN/BAD clear width (between vertical partition x=289.56 and inner face of right exterior wall x=388.35)
findings.explanation: The dimensioned distance measures 98.79 pt = 3.485 m at 1:100, not 4.00 m. Label is 0.515 m too large. Either the label must read 3.49 or the partition must move 0.515 m left (which would then also change the 5.86/5.80 segment).
The room is drawn 5.80 m x 6.40 m clear (164.41 x 181.42 pt at 1:100) = 37.12 m2. The label states 31.2 m2, understating the area by 5.9 m2. (Looks like a digit transposition of 37.1.)

The room is drawn 3.485 m x 4.085 m clear (98.79 x 115.80 pt at 1:100) = 14.24 m2, not 13.4 m2. Also note the three area labels are mutually inconsistent: no single room width/height can produce 31.2 / 13.4 / 6.9 within a 10.00 x 7.00 m envelope.
The room is drawn 3.485 m x 2.20 m clear (98.79 x 62.36 pt at 1:100) = 7.67 m2, not 6.9 m2. Sum of the three labels is 51.5 m2 while the drawn net floor area is 59.0 m2.

findings.kind: door swing not aligned with its opening
findings.element: SCHLAFEN door in the vertical partition wall (opening at y = 504.57...532.91, i.e. 1.00 m wide)
findings.explanation: The 1.00 m opening in the partition (white gap, y 504.57-532.91) has no door leaf in it. The door leaf and quarter-circle swing are drawn one full door width (28.35 pt = 1.00 m) above the opening: hinge/closed leaf runs from y 504.57 up to 476.22, which is solid wall. Either the opening or the door symbol must be moved 1.00 m so they coincide.

summary: Seven problems: the top dimension chain sums to 10.575 m against a 10.00 m overall dimension, driven by two segment labels (5.86 vs. drawn 5.80 m; 4.00 vs. drawn 3.485 m). All three room area annotations are also too small compared with the drawn geometry (WOHNEN 31.2 vs. 37.12 m2, SCHLAFEN 13.4 vs. 14.24 m2, BAD 6.9 vs. 7.67 m2) and are mutually inconsistent, so they cannot simply be re-fitted to a different partition position. Finally, the SCHLAFEN door leaf and swing are drawn 1.00 m above the actual wall opening. The 1:100 scale, the 10.00 x 7.00 m envelope, the 30 cm exterior walls, the 11.5 cm partitions, the entrance and bathroom doors, and the title block all check out.
